name: Fishing and boat charter

pf.license.need: always, to carry paying passengers: each captain holds the federal captain's license for the boat's waters and passenger count (a 6-passenger license for an uninspected boat, a master's license for an inspected boat), with the drug-testing program and medical certificate it requires; the business holds any charter or fishing guide license where the state's rules require one; each boat has its own registration or federal documentation, and an inspected boat its certificate of inspection
pf.license.who: each captain, for their license, drug-testing enrollment and medical certificate; the business, for any state charter or guide license; each boat, for its own papers
pf.license.ask: the business registration and any state charter or guide license; each captain's license number, its passenger limit and end date; each boat's registration or documentation number, its passenger limit, and for an inspected boat its certificate of inspection
pf.license.check: none: Rosie never looks up, checks or confirms a license, insurance or registration (D96); anything shown is as given by the business, not checked by Rosie
pf.license.scope: a captain is offered only for boats and passenger counts their license covers
pf.license.blocks: a boat goes live only with a licensed captain on file and its own papers in date; the business only with its state charter license where the state requires one
pf.license.renewals: optional reminders the owner sets; a license the owner says has lapsed pauses that person's new bookings for that work (the owner's word, never a check)
pf.license.insurance: liability and boat insurance, shown only once proof is sent
pf.license.how it's checked: Not checked by Rosie. Each captain's federal license, the boat's papers and the inspection certificate are the owner's own, shown as given (D96).

pf.services.shape: table: a boat booked for a set trip time by one group (a space with a passenger limit); a shared trip sells seats on a set departure (a seat in a session)
pf.services.examples: the example charter's own prices (Lee Sportfishing), not a standard

list.name: Private half-day inshore charter
list.price: $600 for up to 4 anglers, $50 each extra up to 6
list.where: leaves from the example marina, slip 12
list.after: the rest paid at the dock before leaving, the business's own way
list.note: rods, reels, bait and tackle included

list.name: Charter with dock pick-up
list.where: the captain picks the group up at their own dock or a hotel marina within 10 miles by water (flow B)
list.after: the rest charged to the saved card when the captain texts DONE

list.name: Fish cleaning
list.length: at the dock after the trip
list.before: added at the dock, with the group's yes

list.name: Extra hour on the water
list.length: added during the trip, if the next trip allows

pf.services.capacity: each boat's passenger limit, from its papers and the captain's license (6 for an uninspected boat); a booking never goes over it; children count as passengers
pf.services.minimum: a shared trip runs with 3 anglers, counted at 6pm the evening before; too few: Sam runs it or cancels with a full refund
pf.services.trips: set trip times each day; one boat does at most two half-day trips
pf.services.skills: inshore, offshore, fly fishing; which boats each captain is licensed and insured to run
pf.services.notBookings: rods, tackle, bait, ice, drinks and clothing sold at the dock stay outside Rosie; the catch is never sold through a booking

beforeTimes: a private boat, or a seat on a shared trip
how many people in all, adults and children (sets the price and must fit the boat's limit)
inshore or offshore, and the date
for a pick-up: the kind of place (a home dock or a hotel marina) and the town
afterTime: anything the captain should know: first time on a boat, a target fish, a celebration
who will fish, and the children's ages
securePage: each passenger's name for the passenger list, and an emergency contact on shore
each passenger's waiver, signed by that passenger, or by a parent or guardian for a child
each angler's fishing license number where the boat's license doesn't cover its passengers
health details a passenger wants the captain to know (a heart condition, pregnancy, a recent surgery, trouble climbing)
for a pick-up: the dock's street address and how to reach it
pf.questions.whoMayBook: an adult books for the group; children come with an adult from the group, who stays on board with them
pf.questions.told: be at the slip 30 minutes before the trip; the boat's rules (no glass, soft-soled shoes, alcohol only as the captain allows); the captain makes the weather call; the boat waits 15 minutes for a late group

stop.words: someone overboard or a boat in trouble on the water right now
stop.say: Call 911, or the Coast Guard on VHF channel 16 if you're on the water.

stop.words: someone unwell right now: chest pain, trouble breathing, a bad fall

goOn.words: pregnant, a heart condition, a recent surgery, trouble walking or climbing
goOn.what: the booking goes on; the captain reads the private note before the trip and may say the trip isn't safe for that person; Rosie gives no health advice
the booking goes on; the reminder suggests asking a pharmacist or doctor about seasickness options ahead of time

pf.safety.boarding: a passenger who seems drunk or high, or won't follow the captain's safety rules, doesn't board; the captain's word is final, and the rest of the group's trip goes on
pf.safety.onTheWater: a safety talk before leaving; life jackets for everyone, and children wear theirs as the federal rules require; an emergency on the water: the captain calls the Coast Guard first, then Sam is told
pf.safety.weather: the captain makes the go or no-go call from the marine forecast for the waters fished (wind, waves, a small craft advisory, lightning), the evening before and again at the dock; a trip can turn back early for safety

steps: each passenger's waiver on the secure page before the trip (a parent or guardian signs for a child), good for the season
the passenger list (names and a shore contact) on the secure page by 6pm the evening before
fishing licenses: where the boat's license doesn't cover its passengers, each angler who needs one buys it before the trip, and the number goes on the secure page
pf.first_steps.prep: at the slip 30 minutes early; soft-soled shoes, layers, sunscreen and a hat; food and drinks in a soft cooler, no glass; ask a pharmacist about seasickness options ahead of time; fishing licenses where needed

pf.visit.checkIn: at the slip the captain or mate takes the booker's code, checks the passenger list against who's there, and counts heads against the boat's limit
pf.visit.grace: the boat waits 15 minutes for a late group, then may leave; a private trip still ends at its set time
pf.visit.changes: fish cleaning or an extra hour is priced first and the group says yes; an extra hour only if the next trip allows
pf.visit.endEarly: a trip the group asks to end early (seasick, cold) is the full price; a trip the captain turns back for weather or a boat problem follows the captain's terms: back within half the trip time, a free rain check or half the price back
pf.visit.done: the captain texts DONE back at the dock; the rest is paid there

pf.money.before: a deposit holds a private trip (about 25%); a shared seat is paid in full
pf.money.after: the rest paid at the dock before leaving (card, cash or check, the business's own way), or charged to the saved card at DONE for a pick-up trip
pf.money.cancel: free to cancel up to 72 hours before; later, the deposit may be kept, only with Sam's yes; the captain's weather call: a full refund or a new date, the group picks
pf.money.groupPays: one person books and pays the deposit; at the dock the group pays the rest together, or splits it, the business's own way
pf.money.tips: a tip for the crew is the group's choice, in cash at the dock; Rosie never asks
pf.money.caps: deposits within the state's limits where they apply
pf.money.fee2: Rosfield's $2 per confirmed booking applies: one $2 per trip, however many on board

pf.messages.never: passengers' health details, shore contacts, fishing license numbers and dates of birth: only on the secure page
pf.messages.staffTexts: the captain's day list shows the booker's name and the number on board; the passenger list opens only on the captain's signed-in phone
pf.messages.minors: texts go to the adult who booked

pf.staff.licenses: each captain's federal license for the boat and passenger count, with drug testing and a medical certificate; a mate needs no license unless the boat's papers require a licensed crew
pf.staff.skills: which boats each captain may run; inshore, offshore, fly fishing
pf.staff.crews: a 6-passenger trip: a captain, with a mate on full days; an inspected boat: the crew its certificate requires
pf.staff.standIn: another captain licensed and insured for that boat and passenger count; a group that asked for a captain by name is asked first, and nobody moves on silence
pf.staff.oks: Sam OKs refunds, rain checks and extra hours past the trip time

pf.rules.passengers: never more passengers than the boat's papers and the captain's license allow
pf.rules.safety: life jackets for everyone on board; children wear theirs as the rules require; a safety talk before leaving
pf.rules.fishing: fishing licenses, catch limits and seasons follow the rules of the waters fished; the captain decides what's kept; Rosie never promises a catch
pf.rules.alcohol: only as the captain allows; no glass
pf.rules.records: the passenger list for each trip kept with the booking for 7 years
pf.rules.cancelRight: no cancel period for time on the water already given
pf.rules.reviews: a rating once after the trip

pf.edges.weatherCall: the captain calls it the evening before or at the dock from the marine forecast: the group gets a new date or a full refund
pf.edges.turnBack: the captain turns back for weather or a boat problem: back within half the trip time, a free rain check or half back; later than that, Sam decides
pf.edges.endEarly: the group asks to come in early: the full price
pf.edges.boatOut: a boat problem before the trip: another boat that fits, a new date, or a full refund
pf.edges.captainOut: another licensed captain for that boat; a group that named a captain is asked first; nobody moves on silence
pf.edges.tooMany: more people at the dock than the boat may carry: only up to the limit board
pf.edges.impaired: a passenger who seems drunk doesn't board; the group's trip goes on without them; no refund for that person
pf.edges.noLicense: an angler without a needed fishing license can ride along but not fish; the trip goes on
pf.edges.minors: children with an adult from the group, in a life jacket
pf.edges.other: all other edge cases the generic way

story.A: Sam Lee signs up two companies by text. Then Alex M. books a private half-day inshore charter for 4 from Lee Charters, Sat Oct 24 at 11:00am. Gus meets the group at the dock, and the $150 deposit holds the boat.
story.B: Sam Lee signs up two companies by text. Then Alex M. books Lee Sportfishing for a full day with pick-up at the group's dock, 14 Cedar Ln. Ruth and Rafe pick up the group Thu Oct 22 at 6:00am, and the rest is charged to Alex's saved card when the captain texts DONE.

A.staff: Gus and Ana (captains at the dock)

B.other: Others (a marina, a group, a bank)

examples.list|deposit|counter: The main story: a private half-day inshore charter for 4: $600, a $150 deposit when booking, the $450 rest paid at the dock before leaving.
examples.list|full|none: A seat on a shared trip, $140, paid in full when booking.

examples.list|deposit|card: The main story: a full-day charter with dock pick-up: $675 ($600 plus the $75 pick-up). A $150 deposit when booking; the $525 rest charged to the saved card when the captain texts DONE.

notes: Fishing and boat charter (table style; from rentals, with the verified sample plug-in as the base, work/testdrive/fishing-charter.md). Refit for the rebuilt master (N4, Oct 27): the sample's money words are gone and money is the amounts rows. Flow A (Lee Charters, the group comes to the dock): a private half-day inshore charter for up to 4, $600, a $150 deposit when booking, the $450 rest paid at the dock before leaving (the deposit kept on a late cancel); a shared-trip seat, $140, paid in full ($30 kept on a late cancel). Flow B (Lee Sportfishing, the captain picks the group up at their own dock): a full-day charter with pick-up, $675 ($600 plus the $75 pick-up), a $150 deposit, the $525 rest charged to the saved card when the captain texts DONE. The rest is never charged on a set day. The captain's weather call and the marine forecast are the sample's verified rules. Licenses: each captain's federal license, the boat's papers and inspection are the owner's own, shown as given, never checked (D96). $2 applies once per trip (D97). Sensitive is off. The verified sample findings (work/gaps/fishing-charter.json) stand.
